question: What results are assigned to performing the rite in Jyeshtha and Ashadha?
premises: The verse says in Jyeshtha it is death-giving.
It says in Ashadha it is kin-destroying.
inference: Performing the rite in Jyeshtha gives death, and in Ashadha destroys kin.
plain_english: In Jyeshtha it is death-giving; in Ashadha, kin-destroying.
